_notes: source: canon = on-screen; beta = licensed books/games; original = invented for this game. tier: raw | flow | strategic | exotic | refined | faction | trade_good | part | spare | construction | drone. Trade goods are sold for latinum rather than spent. Raw ores are what surface mines and mining crawlers dig up; an Ore Refinery turns them into the flow metals (refine in resources = what it becomes). Parts, spare kits and construction parts (resources/parts.json) are made at a Machine Shop from the recipes in surfaces/fabrication.json; volume = storage space a unit takes on a surface (1 when not given); description = the item card's text (parts.json; required for part items).
